the spacing effect and working memory resources depletion have a significant impact on the learning process.

(1) working memory resources depletion occurs after exerting a significant cognitive effort and is reversed after a rest period; and (2) working memory resources are more likely to be depleted when students are required to perform a task with a high level of working memory demand, which is associated with a high level or working memory load.
working memory is a limited resource that depletes with time and that the spacing effect is a phenomenon that can be used to manage cognitive load in instruction.
